name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen cabinet and countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen cabinet and countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen cabinet and countertop installation typically ranges from 3 to 8 weeks, but can vary. Custom cabinet orders take the longest, often 4-6 weeks for manufacturing alone. Once cabinets are installed, countertop templates are usually made, followed by fabrication and installation, which can take an additional 1-2 weeks. Factors like material availability, complexity of the design, and contractor scheduling can influence the overall duration. We provide a detailed project schedule at the start of every remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 3 to 8 weeks, depending on cabinet type (custom vs. stock) and countertop material lead times.
